title: Kill-Chain Canaries: Stage-Level Tracking of Prompt Injection Across Attack Surfaces and Five Production LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2603.28013v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multi-agent LLM systems now read documents, web pages and tool results on behalf of users, yet their resistance to prompt injection is usually reported as one number: did the attack succeed? We introduce a kill-chain canary method that plants a unique token in every injected payload and records the furthest of four stages it reaches (Exposed -> Persisted -> Relayed -> Executed), across 950 runs, five production LLMs, six attack surfaces, and five defense conditions. Exposure was 100% among runs that called the tool; the outcomes differ downstream. Claude Haiku 4.5 and Claude Sonnet 4.5 executed none of their 164 text-surface attacks, and in the text relay the canary token never appeared in a memory write (0/40); GPT-4o-mini executed 53% of its attacks. translated_title: 杀伤链金丝雀：跨攻击面与五个生产级大语言模型的提示注入阶段级追踪
translated_abstract: 多智能体大语言模型系统如今代表用户阅读文档、网页和工具结果，然而它们对提示注入的抵抗力通常只用一个数字来报告：攻击是否成功？我们引入了一种“杀伤链金丝雀”方法，在每个注入的有效载荷中植入一个唯一的令牌，并记录其到达的四个阶段中最远的阶段（暴露 -> 持久化 -> 中继 -> 执行），涵盖950次运行、五个生产级大语言模型、六个攻击面和五种防御条件。在调用工具的运行中，暴露率为100%，但下游结果各不相同。Claude Haiku 4.5和Claude Sonnet 4.5在其164次文本表面攻击中均未执行任何攻击，且在文本中继中，金丝雀令牌从未出现在内存写入中（0/40）；而GPT-4o-mini执行了其53%的攻击。由此得出四项发现。（1）Claude写入器在所报告的每次中继运行中都将金丝雀令牌排除在共享内存之外；其中一种跨模型配对（Claude写入器，GPT-4o-mini读取器，n =……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“杀伤链金丝雀”方法，通过在注入载荷中植入唯一令牌并追踪其在暴露、持久化、中继、执行四个阶段中最远到达的阶段，实现了对五个生产级大语言模型提示注入攻击的细粒度阶段级评估，揭示了不同模型在攻击实际执行层面的显著安全差异。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a "kill-chain canary" method that plants a unique token in every injected payload and tracks the furthest of four stages it reaches (Exposed, Persisted, Relayed, Executed), enabling fine-grained stage-level evaluation of prompt injection across five production LLMs and revealing significant differences in how models actually execute attacks downstream.
